description: This file defines the SDT class within the Thunder::Broadcast::DVB namespace, representing a Service Description Table (SDT) for DVB broadcasting. It includes nested classes for iterating over services and provides methods to access service and table information, such as service IDs, running modes, and descriptors.

classes.name: SDT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Service Description Table, providing access to table data and service entries.

classes.name: SDT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within the SDT, providing methods to access service properties.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service entry.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::ServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID of the current service.

methods.name: SDT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the services contained in the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID associated with the SDT.
